Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate a small, hypoplastic left hemithorax with volume loss and mediastinal shift to the left, alongside an absent or markedly diminished left pulmonary artery shadow. These findings, combined with the description of "long-standing abnormalities," are classic for congenital agenesis of the left pulmonary artery, which is frequently associated with a right aortic arch.
